career.title: Frontend Developer
career.description: Build the parts of a website people see and use, combining content, design and interaction.

roadmap.title: Frontend foundations
roadmap.description: Build an accessible resource page with a working search interaction.

milestones.title: Web foundations
milestones.description: Understand browser delivery and build semantic, responsive pages.

topics.title: How the web works
topics.explanation: Explain how a browser requests a URL and receives HTML, CSS, JavaScript or data from a server.

topics.title: Semantic HTML
topics.explanation: Structure a page using meaningful headings, navigation, main content, links and labeled form controls.

topics.title: CSS and layout
topics.explanation: Use the box model, spacing, typography, Flexbox and Grid to build a readable page that reflows.

topics.title: Accessible responsive pages
topics.explanation: Use semantic controls, explicit labels, visible focus and sufficient contrast. Check that every interaction works by keyboard.

milestones.title: Your first interactive page
milestones.description: Combine structure, presentation and browser behavior in a small project.

topics.title: JavaScript fundamentals
topics.explanation: Use values, conditions, functions and events to update page content. Explain the interaction and make it keyboard operable.

topics.title: Build a resource page
topics.explanation: Build a responsive resource list with descriptive links and a labeled search filter. Check its empty result, keyboard and narrow-view states.
